assumptions: Concentric circular rings in the body equator; radius and width are held fixed at one measured contact instead of inventing unsampled azimuthal structure.

Use the normal opacity numerically as an explicitly schematic constant display alpha; it is occultation transmission evidence, not reflected-light brightness or a complete view-dependent optical model.
Neutral gray is display content; no spatially resolved ring-color texture is available.
The 2021 equivalent width of C2R (0.117 km) is opacity times radial width, and MUST NOT be used as a geometric ring width.
